purpose: Keep scheduler delivery jitter separate from reasoning-worker utilization so P0 diagnosis does not blame the wrong layer.

observations.source: automation run context and durable successor observation

interpretation: The scheduler boundary is not an exact wall-clock handoff boundary even under exact_schedule. Utilization measurement must use actual worker/successor observations, while expected due remains a fencing/recovery reference. A 60-second handoff margin can be consumed by observed delivery jitter, so faster event/overlap continuation remains strategically important even if the hard continuation gate succeeds.
next_action: Append each successor expected/observed pair. After >=10 samples compute median and p90 absolute delivery offset and use it to size scheduled fallback overlap margin without changing the event-driven fast-path goal.
